_comment: Group Partnership Pack template. Copy to <group-slug>.json and link at /group-pack/<group-slug>. Group packs pitch a preferred-partner framework (endorsement + pilot at one school) rather than a single-school trip approval. The pilot cohort fields (yearGroup, cohortSize, travelDates, perStudentUSD) describe the FIRST proposed cohort; group economics (schoolCount, schoolFootprint) describe the rollout potential.
existingCSR: any existing community-partnership work the group runs
